explanation: Oxygen is a non-metal. Accept any defensible rule a learner can argue for — the reasoning is the point.
Chloroplasts are for photosynthesis; the others appear in typical animal cells too. Other rules may also work.
Photosynthesis builds glucose; the others move substances or release energy. Defend another grouping if you can.
HDMI is a display connection; the others are core computer components. Other rules welcome.
